change_scope: Only commit author/committer metadata was sanitized before publication. All other commit headers, parent and message bytes are unchanged; the complete source and test Git trees are identical.
measurement_scope: Reports retain the original measured candidate commit and original binary versions and digests. Source, tests, included measured driver and measurement payloads are unchanged. This mapping does not assert that a later rebuilt binary is byte-identical to a measured binary.
record_kind: Published source identity mapping; original measurements unchanged
